depiction.primary_object: laptop computer and smartphone side by side
modifiers: diagonal slash from top-left to bottom-right
depiction.composition: two overlapping device outlines crossed out by a diagonal line

readings.meaning: digital detox, no screens, or screen-free time
disconnect or unlink phone and computer

ambiguity: At small sizes, the smartphone with its camera dot can look like a door with a peephole or a small speaker tower next to a monitor.

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a laptop and a smartphone crossed out by a diagonal slash, representing either unlinking/disconnecting devices or taking a screen-free digital detox. While somewhat niche, it fits both technical device-management tasks and lifestyle screen-time reduction tasks well, though at very small sizes the geometry is slightly busy.
